Klasse ECDHUtils

java.lang.Object
de.bundeswehr.uniity.sedapexpress.utils.ECDHUtils
public final class ECDHUtils extends Object
Provides Elliptic-Curve Diffie-Hellman operations restricted to the BrainpoolP256r1 curve.

Key-pair generation uses the single shared random generator EncryptionUtils.random. The ECDH result is treated as raw shared secret material and is passed to the common HKDF-SHA-256 implementation in EncryptionUtils to derive the final AES key. The SEDAP-Express profile uses a 32-byte salt.

Callers must authenticate the exchange transcript; ECDH by itself does not authenticate the communicating peers.

  • Methodendetails

    • generateKeyPair

      public static KeyPair generateKeyPair() throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException, InvalidAlgorithmParameterException
      Generates an ephemeral ECDH key pair on BrainpoolP256r1. The EncryptionUtils.random instance is supplied to the key-pair generator.
      Gibt zurück:
      newly generated BrainpoolP256r1 public/private key pair
      Löst aus:
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if the configured provider does not implement ECDH
      NoSuchProviderException - if the Bouncy Castle provider is unavailable
      InvalidAlgorithmParameterException - if the provider rejects BrainpoolP256r1

    • isBrainpoolP256r1

      private static boolean isBrainpoolP256r1(ECKey key) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException, InvalidKeyException
      Determines whether an EC key uses the exact BrainpoolP256r1 domain parameters.
      Parameter:
      key - EC public or private key whose parameters are to be checked
      Gibt zurück:
      true if the curve, base point, subgroup order, and cofactor match BrainpoolP256r1; false otherwise
      Löst aus:
      InvalidKeyException - if the key has no EC parameters or the expected curve parameters cannot be loaded
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if the EC algorithm-parameters implementation is unavailable
      NoSuchProviderException - if the Bouncy Castle provider is unavailable

    • getSharedSecretKeyHKDFSHA256

      public static byte[] getSharedSecretKeyHKDFSHA256(PrivateKey ownSecretKey, PublicKey otherPublicKey, KEYEXCHANGE.AESKeyLength aesKeyLength, byte[] salt) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException, InvalidKeyException
      Performs ECDH with the local private key and remote public key on BrainpoolP256r1, then derives an AES-128 or AES-256 key using HKDF-SHA-256.
      Parameter:
      ownSecretKey - local BrainpoolP256r1 EC private key
      otherPublicKey - remote peer's BrainpoolP256r1 EC public key
      aesKeyLength - negotiated output AES key length (128 or 256 bits)
      salt - common 32-byte HKDF salt supplied identically by both peers
      Gibt zurück:
      derived AES key, 16 bytes for AES-128 or 32 bytes for AES-256
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either key is not of the required EC key type, the AES key length is null, or the salt is not exactly 32 bytes
      InvalidKeyException - if either key does not use BrainpoolP256r1 or the key agreement implementation rejects the supplied key material
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if ECDH or HKDF-SHA-256 is unavailable
      NoSuchProviderException - if the Bouncy Castle provider is unavailable
